svg.text: any error here: stop, exit code 1
Exports traceability events and links from PostgreSQL as gzipped RDF N-Quad files for the Dgraph bulk loader, then stamps sync_time on the exported rows.
The binary never connects to Dgraph. It accepts exactly one mode: APP_MODE=initial.
run from a directory that holds config/
Ctrl+C (SIGINT) or SIGTERM cancels the whole run
godotenv — a missing file only prints "No .env file found"
read config/app.yaml, then every field may be overridden
by an environment variable (APP_MODE, DB_CLEAN_*, INITIAL_*, …)
slog, JSON lines to stdout, level from LOGGER_LEVEL
open a connection pool (pgx) and Ping it
rejects any mode other than initial
workers = INITIAL_WORKER_COUNT, else the number of CPUs
chunk size = INITIAL_CHUNK_SIZE, else 1,000,000 records per file
delete ./initial_imports/ entirely, then create it again
goroutines in one errgroup: the first error cancels all of them
runs eventsQuery: valid events at either end of a valid link,
enriched with subjects, mv_subject_hierarchy and master_mill
normalise values, skip rows with a blank unique_id,
build one Event node per row: _:event_<id> <predicate> "value" .
repeated values are de-duplicated by a shared string interner
starts a new file every chunk-size records
flush and finish every events*.rdf.gz file
runs linksQuery: valid links whose two events are valid,
skips links with a blank endpoint, writes one edge per link:
same blank-node IDs as Stage 1, so the two files join up
both writers are closed; every file is complete on disk
Stamp sync_time = NOW() on the exported rows
① UPDATE events_bc ② UPDATE links_bc
only rows that were exported AND status = 'valid' AND sync_time IS NULL
each statement commits on its own; links_bc is tried
rows re-selected with the export's own filters, no IDs held in memory
empty value, any other value, or "incremental"
the only external system the binary talks to
the RDF files are complete and kept
nothing is re-exported; re-run the two UPDATEs by hand
Afterwards — outside this binary (manual steps, not part of the code)
daily sync picks up rows with sync_time IS NULL
— the stamp keeps it from redoing the bootstrap
